input.quote: b) The total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action, whether contract or tort, is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action.
input.rationale: Section 15.3 b) is the only monetary cap in the Base Agreement. It is mutual (good), and 15.3 a) contains a mutual consequential-damages waiver, but it fails the fallback on two material terms. First, the cap basis is 3% of the bill-of-materials value of all Products delivered over the whole term — a small fraction of the charges IBM pays MSL, and therefore materially below the fallback of twelve months' fees (and likely below six months' fees, i.e. walk-away territory). Second, there are no carve-outs anywhere: MSL's indemnity in 15.1 (third-party IP infringement, legal non-compliance, warranty failures), the confidentiality obligations in 13.2 and the AECI, gross negligence and willful misconduct all sit inside this cap with no super-cap, which the playbook treats as walk-away. The one-sided $25,000 limit in the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement §15 (p1574–p1575) caps MSL's remedies against IBM and benefits us, so we do not touch it. Redline resets the mutual cap to the greater of twelve months' charges and US$1,000,000 and adds a single Excluded Claims sentence.

ops.oldText: is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action.
ops.newText: is limited to the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by IBM to MSL under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the action and (b) one million U.S. dollars (US$1,000,000). This limitation does not apply to Excluded Claims, which means a Party's indemnification obligations under this Agreement, a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, a Party's gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, a Party's infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights, and IBM's obligation to pay amounts properly due under this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We reset the mutual cap to the greater of twelve months' charges and US$1,000,000, because 3% of bill-of-materials value is well below our minimum of twelve months' fees. We also added the standard carve-outs so indemnification, confidentiality/security breaches, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, together with IBM's payment obligations.
proposal.summary: Replace 3%-of-BOM cap with mutual greater-of 12 months' charges / US$1m cap and add uncapped Excluded Claims carve-outs.
